evidence_refs.quote: Nettle, an AI platform for commercial insurance loss control, has raised $4.8 million in an oversubscribed seed round.

Nettle unifies risk identification, evidence gathering, analysis and reporting within a single platform.

The platform can flag potential exposures remotely using AI and external data ahead of any site visit, and offers guided inspections so that risk engineers, agents and policyholders can gather data in a consistent way. Built for enterprise insurers, Nettle supports cloud and on-premise deployment, regional data residency, and enterprise-grade security.

subsector.name: 数据中心与算力基础设施

evidence_refs.quote: Clockwork.io, whose fault-tolerance software keeps AI training, reinforcement learning and inference workloads running through infrastructure failures, today announced $31 million in new funding
Clockwork.io, a Palo Alto-based company that provides fault-tolerance software for AI infrastructure, has announced $31 million in new funding.
TorchPass moves work from a failing GPU to a healthy one so training continues instead of rolling back.
Multi-node platform snapshots, an industry first for training, save an entire running job across every node without changes to the training code and preserve it for recovery.
LinkPass reroutes traffic around a failed link so the job never sees the fault.
LinkPass intercepts link failures the moment they happen and rebalances traffic across the node’s other NICs
FleetLens detects slow or failing jobs and definitively rules whether the fabric is to blame. When it is, FleetLens pinpoints the exact link, switch or NIC at fault.
Clockwork.io's FleetLens platform recovers that lost capacity: nanosecond-accurate telemetry pinpoints the GPU, node, or link slowing or stalling a job, validates clusters before launch

tags.rationale: Clockwork.io 为 AI 训练与推理提供容错软件，保障 GPU 集群与网络链路稳定运行，属于算力基础设施软件。
